definitions.explanation: An explanation using diagrams, charts, or illustrations to make something easier to understand. Also refers to the diagram itself.

examples.japanese: {図解|ずかい}でわかりやすく{説明|せつめい}する。
examples.english: I explain it clearly using a diagram.

examples.japanese: この{教科書|きょうかしょ}は{図解|ずかい}が{多|おお}くて{理解|りかい}しやすい。
examples.english: This textbook has many diagrams and is easy to understand.

examples.japanese: {仕組|しく}みを{図解|ずかい}つきで{紹介|しょうかい}している{記事|きじ}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found an article that explains the mechanism with illustrations.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in publishing, education, and presentations. {図解|ずかい}する means to illustrate or explain with diagrams. Very common in book titles, especially for introductory or reference works.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {図解|ずかい}つき (with illustrations; illustrated)
- {図解|ずかい}で{説明|せつめい}する (to explain with diagrams)
- {図解|ずかい}{入門|にゅうもん} (illustrated introduction — common book title format)
- {図解|ずかい}{事典|じてん} (illustrated encyclopedia)
